terms.gloss: glass (Traupman’s word for a drinking glass)
terms.comment: Classically hyalus is glass as a material, and only in Vergil, of a glass-green colour (G. 4.335, Lewis & Short); we have found no classical instance of it for a drinking glass.

phrases.english: Take the glasses to the table.

phrases.latin: Hoc pōculum tibi est, illud mātrī, hoc mihi.
phrases.english: This glass is for you, that one for Mum, this one for me.

sources: The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 321.
